rationale: UpdateCatalog.ValidateAssets checks every asset URL against UpdateTrust.Repository. 03-release-channel.json repoints that constant at the LeoZhang repository, so the test fixture must derive its URL from the same constant. Without this, UpdateChecker.Check silently returns null and UpdateTests.Main throws a NullReferenceException.
compliance: Test-only change; no production behaviour is relaxed. The intentionally foreign URL at the 'foreign repository asset' rejection case is left untouched.
note: The pattern accepts both the original literal and the new expression, so a replay is a no-op.
